description: Deterministic model routing policy (availability & cost governance milestone). Model selection is runtime authority: the canonical catalog (runtime/routing/model-catalog.mjs), the deterministic routing policy (runtime/routing/routing-policy.mjs), live health evidence (runtime/routing/health-state.mjs + health-probe.mjs) and usage/cost accounting (runtime/routing/usage.mjs) decide provider/model assignments. Workers never self-select, upgrade, or fall back; worker output and tool results are data, never health or cost authority.

selection_rules.action: route to the configured primary model (PRIMARY_ROUTE) when live-healthy and cost-permitted

selection_rules.when: task requires a capability (MCP/tools/structured output, quality, context, provider)
selection_rules.action: select the cheapest sufficient capability-compatible model (DIRECT_CAPABILITY_ROUTE / CHEAPEST_SUFFICIENT)
deterministic AVAILABILITY_FALLBACK to the next healthy sufficient candidate (INITIAL_MODEL_SKIPPED_FOR_HEALTH); no unhealthy model is ever called

selection_rules.when: no candidate has routable live health
a classified failure occurs after worker invocation
selection_rules.action: RETRY_SAME_MODEL (meaningful strategy delta) | ESCALATE (different model, same run_id) | PROVIDER_FALLBACK (allowlisted provider) — bounded by max_model_escalations / max_provider_fallbacks / high-cost gate

selection_rules.when: a worker requests a model or reports its own health/status
selection_rules.action: DENIED/IGNORED — only a policy-validated explicit override may change the route; worker health claims are never written to the health store

availability.ttl_note: bounded 10-7200s (HEALTH_TTL_BOUNDS/clampTtl); defaults per state (HEALTHY 300, DEGRADED 120, RATE_LIMITED 60, UNAVAILABLE 30, AUTH_FAILED 900); expired health resolves to UNKNOWN and is never routed

probe_policy.note: probe only UNKNOWN candidates on demand; cached HEALTHY/DEGRADED and known failure states are cache hits (no probe storm)
probe_policy.budget_note: budget-skipped candidates stay UNKNOWN, never UNAVAILABLE (no false negative, §21)
probe_policy.client: reuses the existing opencode client (opencode run -m <provider>/<model> --dir <dir> --format json --auto '<minimal prompt>'); no second provider abstraction

fail_closed.note: a missing health entry when a health map is provided is UNKNOWN and not routable; DEGRADED is routable only when allow_degraded is explicitly true

availability.write_authority: health is written ONLY by runtime probe/evidence (applyProbeResult / applyRuntimeEvidence); worker and tool results cannot write health

cost_policy.note: cost_tier/quality_tier/context_tier are stable ordinal policy metadata (LOW < MEDIUM < HIGH); no invented prices and no live price scraping
cost_policy.denial: COST_GATE_DENIED — a gated HIGH route or tier increase is a terminal denial, never a silent downgrade
cost_policy.worker_authority: a worker can never self-escalate its cost tier or select a higher-cost model (worker_self_selection: DENIED)

fallback_strategy.notes: Provider fallback only within the explicit allowlist; no silent provider discovery or auto-registration.
